references.name: corridor
references.observed: Operator photo shows low grass and rock-fill grades, separate highway carriageways, verge lamps and shoreline service road. Reuse the map alignment and retain ordinary native roads outside the modeled corridor.

references.name: s1-aerial
references.observed: Ssr aerial, CC BY-SA 3.0. S-1 is a clear wide channel between two flared platforms, with paired white triangular sector gates parked in curved side pockets, service buildings and guide arms. The A-118 runs underneath in a tunnel.

references.name: s2-lift-bridge
references.observed: Operator aerial shows the six-lane low-profile lift bridge, chunky paired mechanical towers and rounded concrete guide platforms with open water below the deck.

operatorFacts.s1: Tunnel beneath clear marine channel and open paired sector gates
operatorFacts.s2: Lift bridge with open navigable channel below deck
